input.question: How are cities built upon each other.
input.ground_truth: Well, IMO, a city goes in rubble after a war, which means people have to rebuild, often using old rubble as foundation materials. Living in Thessaloniki, Greece, Ive realized that my city is built on ancient ruins because it was a hassle to remove or work around._URL_0_

Explain the following question in a simple way as if you are explaining to a 5-year-old.

Question: How are cities built upon each other.

Answer:

response.prediction:
Okay! Imagine you have a big box of building blocks. You start by putting some blocks on the table to make a little house. That’s like the first city a long, long time ago.

Later, you want to build a bigger city, so you put more blocks on top of the old house, or next to it, or even under it if you want to dig a basement. Sometimes, people build new buildings right next to the old ones, or on top of them if they want more space.

So, cities grow by people building new things on top of, next to, or around the old things that are already there. That’s how cities are built upon each other! 🏗️🏙️
